At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Supply Chain Analyst to be based at our WA Office. This role ensures the company’s supply meets the customers’ demand. Duties include overseeing the company’s supply chains, ensuring timely delivery and keeping the company on budget.

Key Responsibilities:
Initiate pre-project risk assessment/review and communicate findings to Key Stakeholders as applicable
Evaluate areas of supply chain operations that require improvement
Be involved in and where practical recommendations during tendering/estimating
Facilitate handover from Sales & conduct formal scope/contract review
Review existing design/build sequence aspects, communicate with Engineering & optimise, increase, or improve profitability throughout the lifetime of the project
Compile and facilitate a detailed P.E.P (project execution plan)

Organisational and time management skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail
Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
Interpersonal and communication skills
Able to communicate with several departments to evaluate and improve operations

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

About the Role
We are currently seeking an experienced Organisation and Methods Analyst to join our team and lead process improvement and organisational optimisation initiatives. This role is ideal for someone with a keen eye for operational efficiency, systems design, and change management who thrives in dynamic, cross-functional environments.
You will work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and operational teams to evaluate current organisational systems, structures, and methods—proposing changes that drive sustainable growth, resource optimisation, and enhanced service delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational systems, processes, workflows, and structures to identify inefficiencies, redundancies, or compliance issues.
Consult with internal stakeholders to understand existing challenges and gather input on improvement opportunities.
Develop detailed process maps, system diagrams, and documentation to visualise and communicate current state and proposed future state.
Evaluate performance data, reports, and job descriptions to identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks.
Recommend actionable solutions to improve productivity, restructure workflows, enhance accountability, and support strategic goals.
Prepare and present proposals for changes to procedures, job functions, and resource allocation.
Assist with the implementation of new procedures or organisational structures, including issuing revised manuals and training documentation.
Monitor compliance with new procedures and assess their impact on performance and service outcomes.
Support change management efforts by facilitating stakeholder workshops, coaching team leads, and managing communication plans.
Collaborate with IT and HR teams where technology or staffing intersects with proposed organisational changes.
Essential Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Organisational Development, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, process improvement, organisational development, or consulting.
Strong capability in mapping and redesigning workflows using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN tools.
Proficiency in gathering, interpreting, and presenting qualitative and quantitative organisational data.
Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships and facilitate workshops or interviews.
High-level written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into actionable business insights.
Understanding of project management, change management, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Agile).
Desirable Qualifications & Certifications
Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt Certification
Prosci Change Management Certification
PRINCE2 or PMP Certification
Advanced Excel or Power BI skills for reporting and data analysis
What We Offer
Exposure to high-impact organisational transformation projects
A collaborative team environment that values innovation and insight
Career development opportunities and professional upskilling
Flexible working arrangements and a strong focus on work–life balance
Pay: AU$70,000.00 – AU$120,000.00 per year

The role of the Analytics & Insights Manager is to be a key driver of insight and strategic thinking. Providing analytics-based strategic insights and directions to aid in the development of media & communications initiatives.
Ensuring a streamlined approach between the strategy, analytics & media teams, ensuring high quality analytical projects are effectively delivered.

•	Experience managing Analytics / MarTech relationships and cross functional stakeholder management

They will provide guidance on the key strategic use cases for Google / Adobe analytics platform, advise on data modelling methods to be used for client business intelligence needs and drive the governance on client Data management processes, platforms & methods.

leverage analytics data for bringing efficiencies in media deliveries and highlighting opportunities for clients to leverage in their everyday business decision making.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across marketing, product, and technology functions to drive effective solutions and achieve strategic business outcomes.   Benefits   Diverse work across projects, implementations, support, and product improvement  Learning and development opportunities  Supportive team culture and collaborative environment  Career growth opportunities within a growing software business  Meaningful involvement in delivering successful customer outcomes    Task & responsibilities   Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions to support business decision-making.   Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.   Prepare meaningful reports and visualisations tailored to stakeholder requirements.   Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather, analyse, and document business requirements.   Develop and deliver Business Intelligence solutions aligned with organisational objectives.   Provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning and operational improvements.   Review existing business systems, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for enhancement.   Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand operational challenges and recommend effective solutions.   Design, implement, and maintain ETL processes frameworks remain scalable, efficient, and adaptable.   Utilise tools such as SSIS, Power Automate, and Azure Data Factory to automate and streamline data processes.   Drive process improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce manual intervention.   Present complex analytical findings in a clear and understandable manner to non-technical stakeholders.   Develop presentations and reports that convert data insights into practical business strategies.           Qualification & experience   At least 1 years of experience in a Business Intelligence or Data Analytics role, preferably within the logistics or freight forwarding sector.   Demonstrated experience working for international freight forwarding organisations in an analytical capacity.   Advanced expertise in Power BI, including dashboard development and data visualisation.   Hands-on experience with CargoWise One software.   Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.   Relevant certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Azure, SQL, Python, or related technologies.   Strong understanding of cloud-based platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.   Proven experience in ETL development and data integration tools, including SSIS and Azure Data Factory.   Working knowledge of Power Automate and workflow automation technologies.   Experience working with multinational teams and clients across different countries, cultures, and business environments will be highly regarded.   About Company     Surf Coast IT Solutions  is a Geelong-based technology firm operating at the intersection of identity verification, education technology, and mobile and cloud-based application development. The company combines a services arm — websites, custom applications, and managed IT — with a portfolio of proprietary EdTech products positioned for the Australian regulated training market and beyond. Our flagship product,  EduVerifi , is one of a small number of Australian platforms holding live integrations with both  IDMatch Australia  (RapidID gateway) and  DigiLocker India , alongside  IELTS  and  PTE  verification through the British Council and Pearson Academic. This regulatory positioning forms the foundation of a defensible moat in a market where compliance is the barrier to entry. Surf Coast IT Solutions is wholly Australian-owned, founder-operated, and profitable through its services arm, which funds ongoing product development. result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are seeking a highly skilled full-time experienced ICT Business Analyst.   

As an ICT Business Analyst, you will be a key figure in the further development of our own proprietary system. The role involves carrying out assessments and analysis of current ICT business processes and making improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.

The daily duties and responsibilities include:
• Acts as a central reference and information source, providing guidance and assistance in the system project decision making process.
• Identifies, investigates, and analyses business processes, procedures and work practices. 
• Identifies and evaluates inefficiencies and recommends optimal business practices, and system functionality and behaviour
• Uses project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
• Collaborate with teams across the business to deliver high quality service outcomes
• Uses data and process modelling techniques to create clear system specifications for the design and development of system software

Education – Bachelor degree or higher qualification desirable. Industry experience may substitute.

Experience & Skills 
• 2+ years’ work experience in a business system analyst role or similar
• Communication & technical skills
• Problem-solving & critical thinking skills
• Excellent time management
• Ability to work collaboratively and independently as required
• Confidence to communicate with multiple stakeholders and to manage expectations

Salary - Salary being offered is commensurate with qualifications and experience and is between $80,000 - $110,000
